question: What has been transmitted to the addressee regarding the practice of the soul?
premises: An address is made to Bhairavī.
This practice of the soul is in question.
It has been told to the addressee.
inference: The practice of the soul has now been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not repeated here.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
